source_text: ἀλλ' εὐθύμους καὶ ἱλαροὺς τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ πολιτείας ἐξῆφθαι πρέπει. Τοῦτο γὰρ, οἶμαι, ἔστι τὸ, «Δεῦτε ἀγαλλιασώμεθα τῷ Κυρίῳ.» Ἐπιλάμψει γὰρ οὕτω καθαρῶς τε καὶ ἐναργῶς ἡ δόξα Χριστοῦ, ἀσμενέστατα προσιεμένη τὰς τῶν ἁγίων καρποφορίας, καθάπερ
pass_b_english: Cyril: …but cheerful and glad it is fitting to have been hung from the citizenship in Christ. For this, I think, is the, ‘Come let us rejoice to the Lord.’ (Leviticus 9:22–24) For thus the glory of Christ will shine upon purely and clearly, most gladly receiving the fruit-bearings of the saints, just as indeed also then God in a form of fire has come down clearly, and has eaten up the victims. And he all but thinks food and luxury the good-repute of those sanctified in faith. And the word also hints something mystical; for then upon the divided-parts God was sending down the tip of fire, as it were somehow touching the things set forth; for the Divine always molds under itself the nature of fire. And now with the intelligible sacrifice being set before him, not in a form of fire, but in holy Spirit, touching the things set forth intelligibly, he shows life-making for those yearning to share, and we have received the matter true in faith.

Cyril: And having raised the hands Aaron blessed the people. And see again how… is for us the distributor of the heavenly goods, in him and through him all things from the Father. And indeed all-divine Paul, ‘Grace to you and peace,’ (2 Corinthians 1:2) he says, ‘from God our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ.’ (Psalm 95:1) So then we are blessed in name of God, and how the manner of this might perhaps come to be, signifying gracefully, he said the praying priest must voice: ‘Lord bless you and keep you, (Numbers 6:24) (Leviticus 9:24)
